articles.title: June Inflation Cools as Energy Prices Dip, But Strait of Hormuz Clashes Threaten Rebound
articles.summary: US consumer prices fell in June, driven by a drop in energy costs, with gas averaging $3.85 per gallon. However, renewed US-Iran tensions have already pushed oil back above $80 a barrel, and analysts warn that $4 gas could return within days.

articles.title: Covid Inquiry: UK Wasted £10bn on PPE That Left NHS Staff ‘Poorly Protected’
articles.summary: The UK Covid inquiry found that nearly £10 billion was squandered on inadequate PPE, leaving health workers vulnerable. The emergency stockpile was depleted within weeks of the pandemic, and a flawed procurement system favored connected suppliers.

articles.title: The Strait of Hormuz Standoff: Why Iran's Hidden Arsenal Keeps a Vital Oil Route Shut
articles.summary: Despite months of U.S. airstrikes and threats, Iran's scattered drones and missiles still menace the Strait of Hormuz, where 20% of the world's oil normally flows. Experts say fully reopening it may require a ground invasion—or a massive, risky naval escort operation.
